summary.text: Cory Robertson is the Libertarian Party nominee for U.S. House in Colorado's 3rd District. The Libertarian Party of Colorado lists him as its candidate for the district; little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Listed by the Libertarian Party of Colorado as its 2026 candidate for Congressional District 3.
Appears on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for U.S. House Colorado District 3, per Ballotpedia.
